title: English Practice Quiz 0912
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A purchase requisition requests approval to ___.
questions.explanation: buy goods or services is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A supplier quotation usually provides ___.
questions.explanation: a proposed price and terms is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Why compare supplier quotations?
options: To assess price, quality and terms
questions.explanation: To assess price, quality and terms is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A purchase order is issued to ___.
options: formally place an order with a supplier
questions.explanation: formally place an order with a supplier is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: What is lead time in purchasing?
options: Time between placing an order and receiving it
questions.explanation: Time between placing an order and receiving it is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A product specification describes ___.
options: the required features or standards of an item
questions.explanation: the required features or standards of an item is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A procurement conflict of interest should be ___.
questions.explanation: declared according to policy is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A delivery note helps verify ___.
questions.explanation: goods delivered against the order is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A supplier evaluation may consider ___.
questions.explanation: quality, reliability and delivery performance is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Before approving an invoice, compare it with ___.
options: the purchase order and evidence of receipt
questions.explanation: the purchase order and evidence of receipt is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.
